_note: Every number here is an input to scripts/cost_compare.py. Prices change; re-check the sources before quoting the result.

frontier_llm.source: Anthropic API list prices (platform.claude.com pricing), standard tier, USD per million tokens
frontier_llm._assumptions: A frontier model needs an instruction (prompt_overhead_tokens) and, on current models, spends some billed reasoning tokens even at low effort (reasoning_tokens_per_call, an estimate). Token counts from our tokenizers are used as a proxy for the frontier tokenizer (roughly +-30%).

self_hosted.source: Render compute plans (render.com/docs/compute-plans for CPU/RAM). Monthly prices are the list prices at the time of writing: VERIFY on render.com/pricing before quoting.

free.notes: spins down after 15 min idle (~1 min to wake); 750 instance-hours/month per workspace

starter.notes: always on; same memory ceiling as free

standard.notes: always on; all three checkpoints fit in memory (no cold swaps)
